name: Doki! Doki! Oisha-san Gokko
source:
Main character is a student who aims to become a fine doctor. Healthcare practitioner suddenly quits, and protagonist is asked to temporarily take his place. Will he be able to treat sick people well and prevent all of the seduce attempts?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
常盘匠是一名立志成为优秀医生的学生。负责诊疗的人突然辞职，他受托暂代其职。他能否妥善医治病人，并抵挡接踵而来的诱惑？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
